examples.text: Pensé que habíamos acordado que no harías más eso.
examples.en: I thought we had agreed you weren't going to do that anymore.

examples.text: Que yo sepa, él no ha llegado jamás a la hora acordada.
examples.en: As far as I know, he has never come on time.

examples.text: Tom se disculpó por incumplir lo acordado.
examples.en: Tom apologized for not doing what he had promised he'd do.
